direct.scope: Serial actual-UMAT elapsed-call timer; separate instrumented job.
limitations: Elapsed-call sum includes clock overhead and possible scheduling.
Empty-pair projection is a diagnostic, not a subtraction or exact overhead correction.
Measures UMAT calls only; excludes other Abaqus material routines and assembly.
Single CPU only; shared counters are not valid for SMP.

native_profile.scope: Native Standard process only; samples after attach, excluding initial startup. Separate 2,000-increment serial solve.
limitations: Self samples exclude time in callees; unknown symbols remain unallocated.
standardU.dll contains UMAT, helper routines and external-database initialization.
Named assembly self samples are a lower bound on identifiable assembly work, not a complete phase timer.
Sampled CPU-time estimates and Abaqus CPU/elapsed timers have different scopes and are not summed or rescaled.
Separate fresh profile; requested symbols are reported only if recovered. Not an unprofiled benchmark observation.
